name: SaaSTEMLY — Software studio
description: A complete website for a software studio or digital agency: a landing page with services, selected work, engagement models, team, testimonials and FAQ; a portfolio of case studies with industry, duration, team size and stack; an about page with values, full team bios and a company timeline; a milestone-by-milestone process page; indicative pricing; a blog; a contact page backed by the Forms plugin; and Terms and Privacy pages. Seeds the Forms plugin (contact form with budget and engagement model) and Site Kit (ProfessionalService schema.org profile, FAQ structured data and a cookie-consent banner). Served by PremiumCMS as is, or forked to GitHub Pages with one-click theme updates.
